changed.fact: alt trailing comma before a closing angle or square bracket ... TK-->>ID: dropped, the same Trait descriptor text either way / else comma before a closing paren: Note kept
changed.original: W --> TT --> TK --> TC --> ID; TC -.-> KEEP
changed.why: Original reaches ID ('the same Trait descriptor text either way') unconditionally after the comma-drop step; the rewrite makes reaching ID conditional on the drop branch, so the paren-comma else branch yields no descriptor text, whereas trait_text always returns its string (collect.rs:493-500).

changed.fact: alt ... else comma before a closing paren
changed.original: TC["trailing comma ... dropped"] -.-> KEEP["comma before a closing paren kept"]
changed.why: Original shows the drop as an unconditional step with the paren-comma rule as a side note; the rewrite turns them into two mutually exclusive branches, though one path can contain both kinds of comma and the replace loop runs on every input (collect.rs:495).
